Description:
Stack creating a VPC and launch EC2 instances within it.
    Deploys KAI-IB Controller and Client Agent.
    **WARNING** This template creates Amazon EC2 instances.
    You will be billed for the AWS resources used if you create
    a stack from this template. **WARNING** This template creates
    role for the launching/deleting instances/subnets/interfaces.
    This role will invoke AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole, please see
    AWS Documentation for details on AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole.

ControllerAMI.default: KAIIB Controller AMI ID for the selected region

AgentAMI.default: KAIIB Agent AMI ID for the selected region

EC2RoleForTags.default: Display Agents by tags in KAIIB UI

KAIIBUIINstanceDNS.Description: DNS name of KAIIB Controller instance

AvailabilityZone.Default: <Select preffered availability zone from drop down>

KeyNameForKAIIBAgent.ConstraintDescription: must be the name of an existing EC2 KeyPair
KeyNameForKAIIBAgent.Description: Name of an existing EC2 KeyPair to enable SSH access to the KAIIB instances

ControllerNetworkCIDR.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.
ControllerNetworkCIDR.Description: This subnet is attached to KAIIB controller and would be used to access the KAIIB controllers' UI

AgentControlCIDR.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.
AgentControlCIDR.Description: KAIIB agents will use this subnet for control plane communication with controller

AllowedSubnet.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.
AllowedSubnet.Description: Subnet range allowed to access deployed AWS resources. Execute 'curl ifconfig.co' to know MyIP or google for "what is my IP"

AgentTestCIDR.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.
AgentTestCIDR.Description: KAIIB agents will use this subnet for test traffic

Username.Description: Team or Individual email id responsible for the Stack

VPCCIDR.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.

EC2RoleForTags.Description: Display Agents by tags in KAIIB UI

AuthUsername.Description: Username for agent to controller authentication

AuthPassword.Description: Password for agent to controller authentication

AuthFingerprint.Description: Fingerprint for agent to controller authentication - OPTIONAL
